review_text_raw: I'm not terribly far into this game, but good god is it scratching the Orwell-formed itch in my brain that's been sitting around for the last few years. It's more like Not Tonight in its mechanics and ease of play/pacing, but it has the right vibe to entertain any Orwell fan (especially if, like me, you were disappointed by Ignorance is Strength).
